title: Extending TotalSegmentator: Predicting Patient and Acquisition Characteristics from CT and MR Images
abstract: arXiv:2608.29348v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Background: Patient details and acquisition metadata are important for clinical decisions, image quality control, and automated research pipelines, but may be missing or unreliable in imaging archives.   Purpose: To develop and evaluate a fast open-source model that predicts patient and acquisition characteristics directly from CT and MR images.   Materials and Methods: Separate 3D ResNet-10 ensembles for CT and MR were trained on 57,291 and 43,200 clinical examinations acquired from 2011 to 2025. Both predicted weight, height, age, sex, contrast presence, vertebral coverage, and image noise. The CT model additionally predicted scanner manufacturer, tube voltage, tube current, convolution kernel, and post-injection time; the MR model predicted sequence class. translated_title: 扩展TotalSegmentator：从CT和MR图像预测患者与采集特征
translated_abstract: 背景：患者详细信息和采集元数据对于临床决策、图像质量控制和自动化研究流程非常重要，但在影像存档中可能缺失或不可靠。目的：开发并评估一种快速的开源模型，直接从CT和MR图像预测患者与采集特征。材料与方法：分别针对CT和MR训练了独立的3D ResNet-10集成模型，训练数据为2011年至2025年间采集的57,291例和43,200例临床检查。两个模型均预测体重、身高、年龄、性别、造影剂使用情况、椎体覆盖范围和图像噪声。CT模型还额外预测扫描仪制造商、管电压、管电流、卷积核和注射后时间；MR模型预测序列类别。性能在内部CT测试集（n=501）、MR测试集（n=636）以及外部CT数据集（n=54）上进行评估。结果：内部CT的平均绝对误差（MAE）为体重3.90 kg、身高3.68 cm、年龄4.42岁……
tldr: 该研究扩展了TotalSegmentator，利用在大规模临床数据上训练的3D ResNet-10集成模型，可直接从CT和MR图像快速预测患者特征（体重、身高、年龄、性别等）及采集参数（管电压、序列类别等），为影像存档中缺失或不可靠的元数据提供开源补充方案。
en_tdlr: This study extends TotalSegmentator with fast, open-source 3D ResNet-10 ensemble models trained on large-scale clinical data that directly predict patient characteristics (weight, height, age, sex) and acquisition parameters (tube voltage, sequence class) from CT and MR images, providing a solution for missing or unreliable metadata in imaging archives.
